translations.title: Dexpanthenol 100 mg Tablet
translations.efficacy: This medicine is used as a supportive treatment for hair loss.
translations.usage: Adults take one tablet three times a day. The treatment period is 6 weeks.
translations.caution: Do not take this if you have ever reacted to it, if you are under 19, for any purpose other than hair loss, or if you have an inherited condition such as galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency or glucose-galactose malabsorption. Talk to a pharmacist before taking it if you are pregnant or breastfeeding, or have ever had a drug allergy. If there is no improvement after about 6 weeks, stop taking it.

summaryTable.Who should be careful: Under 19; not for any purpose other than hair loss
